title: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord
shortDescription: Seminal first-person wireframe dungeon crawler exploring Trebor's maze to reclaim the amulet from Werdna.
historicalSignificance: The grandfather of computer role-playing games, inspiring Final Fantasy, Dragon Quest, and modern dungeon crawlers.
